title: 浅外倾双脚留点
description: 水彩描绘浅外倾墙上双脚留点、身体靠近墙面的稳态。

art_direction.medium: clean cel-shaded sports animation with crisp anatomy and soft environmental light
art_direction.scene: Create an original watercolor illustration of a fictional adult on a shallow overhanging indoor bouldering wall. Large rounded teal handholds and positive low footholds allow both shoes to stay engaged while the climber keeps the hips close to the wall. One knee bends gently for a short upward hand adjustment, with no feet cutting loose or airborne swing. Use a wide side view that clearly reveals the modest wall angle, whole clothed adult, and thick continuous crash mats beneath. Transparent coral washes, pale gray structural planes, and soft gym light establish an original peaceful scene. Preserve credible contact points. Include no captions, logos, dangerous height, or dynamic leap.
